name: mcp-google-ads-transparency-monitor
description: MCP server for Google Ads Transparency Monitor. See every Google ad a company runs: one row per ad from the Ads Transparency Center with format, first and last shown dates, creative link, and permalink, plus a company summary row with the total ad count band. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.
